# Likely Causes of Heartburn After Dinner

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/heart.svg

Intermittent heartburn with a sour taste after meals for 3 weeks is most often due to **acid reflux / GERD** or **indigestion**. In your case, **ibuprofen** and **coffee** can both make reflux more likely or irritate the stomach lining.

## What May Be Going On

- **Acid reflux (GERD):** stomach acid moves up into the esophagus, causing burning and sour taste.
- **Meal-related reflux:** larger, fatty, spicy, or late dinners can trigger symptoms.
- **NSAID irritation:** ibuprofen can irritate the stomach and worsen heartburn.
- **Functional dyspepsia / indigestion:** upper stomach discomfort or fullness without a dangerous cause.
- Less commonly, symptoms can come from **gastritis**, **hiatal hernia**, or **ulcer disease**.

## 2-Week Self-Care Plan

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

Try these changes consistently for 14 days:

- **Eat smaller dinners** and avoid going back for large portions.
- **Stop eating 2–3 hours before bed.**
- **Limit coffee to 1 cup daily** or switch to half-caf/decaf for the trial.
- **Avoid ibuprofen if possible** for 2 weeks; ask a clinician/pharmacist about safer pain options for you.
- **Stay upright after meals** for at least 2–3 hours.
- **Raise the head of your bed** 6–8 inches if symptoms happen at night.
- **Eat slowly** and avoid tight belts or waistbands after meals.
- **Track triggers** so you can spot patterns.

### Foods and Habits to Try First

- **Often helpful**
  - Oatmeal, bananas, rice, toast, apples, non-citrus fruit
  - Lean proteins, vegetables, low-fat yogurt if tolerated
  - Water or non-mint herbal tea

- **Often worse**
  - Coffee, alcohol, chocolate, peppermint
  - Fried or fatty foods
  - Tomato sauces, citrus, spicy foods
  - Carbonated drinks

### Simple Meal Pattern for the Trial

- Breakfast: moderate, not skipped
- Lunch: normal portion
- Dinner: smaller than lunch
- Evening: no snacks unless truly hungry, and keep them light

## When Medical Care Is Needed

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/exclamation-triangle.svg

Seek medical care soon if you notice any of these:

- Symptoms **persist beyond 2 weeks** despite the changes above
- Heartburn happens **most days**, is worsening, or wakes you from sleep
- You need frequent antacids or acid reducers to get through the day
- You develop **difficulty swallowing**, food sticking, or painful swallowing
- You have **recurrent vomiting**
- You notice **black stools**, blood in vomit, or blood in stool
- You get **unexplained weight loss**, loss of appetite, or ongoing upper abdominal pain
- You develop **chest pressure, shortness of breath, sweating, pain spreading to arm/jaw**, or feel faint — urgent evaluation is needed

## 2-Week Symptom Log

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/journal-text.svg

Use this simple log once a day:

- Date:
- Time symptoms started:
- What you ate/drank before symptoms:
- Coffee/caffeine amount:
- Ibuprofen or other pain medicine taken?:
- Symptom type: burning / sour taste / burping / nausea / bloating
- Severity 0–10:
- How long it lasted:
- What helped:
- Did it happen at night?:
- Any warning signs?:

### Quick Example Entry

- Date: Tue
- Time symptoms started: 8:30 PM
- Before symptoms: pasta, tomato sauce, coffee after lunch
- Coffee/caffeine: 2 cups
- Ibuprofen: yes
- Symptom type: burning + sour taste
- Severity: 6/10
- Duration: 1 hour
- What helped: sitting upright, antacid
- Night symptoms: no
- Warning signs: none

## Sources

- NHS heartburn and acid reflux: https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/heartburn-and-acid-reflux/
- NIDDK GER & GERD in adults: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/digestive-diseases/acid-reflux-ger-gerd-adults
- MedlinePlus ibuprofen safety: https://medlineplus.gov/druginfo/meds/a682159.html
